decisions.reason: The plug-in line has its own web page and builds on the established offer, so the firm has committed to it visibly and dropping it would write off a sizable investment.

The digital twin service builds on the established offer and fits the announced direction of integrating with broader systems, so weak early results can still be put down to a market that is only starting up.

It is only mentioned on the website and sits close to the core business, so little is lost by keeping it, but its overlap with the more visibly announced identity service makes consolidation plausible.
The open framework is a product line central to the firm's open, extensible component strategy, so dropping it would undercut the direction the firm has announced.
The firm publicly announced the new Identity Service at launch, and that public commitment makes withdrawing it within a year unlikely.
